methodology.counts: Instrumented npm package source; counts and DOM mutations only, not used for timing.
methodology.timing: Uninstrumented official app with published npm bundles; CPU 4x, 3 rounds, alternating variant order, 16 observations per round. Programmatic click to microtask completion; synchronous style/layout forced and recorded separately.
methodology.profile: Separate readable unminified npm-source build. 4x CPU sampling, select 40 operations and update 16 operations.
methodology.limits: Diagnostic run, not the official benchmark runner or its final-paint timing; hardware differs from screenshot. Larger 10,000-row update is an additional scaling check. Timing noise is substantial, especially short vanilla selection. No official score or improvement percentage inferred.

select.name: checkCustemComponentFunction
select.source: const checkCustemComponentFunction = (target) => typeof target === "function" && !checkFragmentFunction(target) || isObject(target) && "resolve" in target;

select.name: checkSameTagElement
select.source: const checkSameTagElement = (newWDom, originalWDom) => originalWDom.type === "e" && originalWDom.tag === newWDom.tag && !!originalWDom.children && originalWDom.children.length === (newWDom.children && newWDom.children.length);

update.name: checkCustemComponentFunction
update.source: const checkCustemComponentFunction = (target) => typeof target === "function" && !checkFragmentFunction(target) || isObject(target) && "resolve" in target;

update.name: remakeChildrenForDiff
update.source: const remakeChildrenForDiff = (newWDom, isSameType, originalWDom) => isSameType && originalWDom ? remakeChildrenForUpdate(newWDom, originalWDom) : remakeChildrenForAdd(newWDom);

update.name: checkSameTagElement
update.source: const checkSameTagElement = (newWDom, originalWDom) => originalWDom.type === "e" && originalWDom.tag === newWDom.tag && !!originalWDom.children && originalWDom.children.length === (newWDom.children && newWDom.children.length);

limitations: Counts, timings, and CPU profiles use different builds. Counter instrumentation is excluded from timing.
The diagnostic build tool is Vite 5.4.8; upstream declares Vite 5.4.21.
The official runner, native input path and final paint timing are not reproduced.
Shared CSS was served, but Bootstrap glyph fonts were not served; forced-layout timings are not used to infer official results.
Timing noise is substantial for short vanilla selection. No official score or optimization improvement is inferred.
10,000-row select/update are auxiliary scaling experiments, not those screenshot scenarios.
Optimization candidates were not applied or measured.
